reasons: Team contracted by about 12% in March

input.instruction: Write a cold outreach email to the VP Engineering at Daniel Corp. Ground every claim in the supplied hiring signal brief.

candidate_output.subject: Context: lower-cost engineering capacity post-restructure
candidate_output.body:
Hi Daniel,

I saw the announcement that your team contracted by about 12% in March. Companies in your stage often need to maintain delivery output while reducing fully-loaded cost — that is the engagement pattern we run most often.

Tenacious places managed engineering teams under our project management. Senior engineers in Python, data, and ML start from $X,XXX/month, with a one-month minimum and two-week extension blocks. No long-term commitment.

If you are scoping the next twelve months of delivery capacity, I can share two short case studies from mid-market clients who replaced a portion of their delivery cost this way.

Best,
Yabi
Research Partner
Tenacious Intelligence Corporation
gettenacious.com

forbidden_phrases: i hope this email finds you
